description: Generalized model trained across all 3 datasets on 168 proteins, 632k samples
split_strategy: Global protein-aware split — same protein always in same split across datasets

v1_mlp_kmer.architecture: MLP [512,256,128], input=8262 k-mer features (RNA 4-mer + Prot 3-mer + dataset_onehot + extras)
v1_mlp_kmer.failure_mode: Val AUROC peaked at epoch 1 then monotonically degraded. Root cause: RNA length mismatch (RBNS 20nt vs HTR-SELEX 40nt) → k-mer frequency distributions incompatible across datasets. StandardScaler cannot fix a structural feature mismatch.
v1_mlp_kmer.conclusion: k-mer MLP not viable for cross-dataset training.

v2_cnn_raw_seq.architecture: Dual-branch CNN: RNA branch (4-ch in, filters [128,256,256], kernels [7,5,3]) + Protein branch (20-ch in, filters [128,256,256], kernels [11,7,5]) → global max pool → concat 512-d → MLP [256,64] → logit
v2_cnn_raw_seq.input: Raw one-hot sequences. RNA padded to 60nt, Protein to 300aa.
v2_cnn_raw_seq.interpretation: CNN V2 successfully resolves the RNA length mismatch — val AUPRC improves steadily across all 28 epochs (no degradation as with MLP). RBNS proteins remain harder: shorter RNA (20nt) provides fewer convolutional filter activations. Gap vs ZHMolGraph remains large — one-hot CNN lacks semantic protein representation. ESM-2 embeddings needed.
v2_cnn_raw_seq.action: Proceed to V3: ESM-2 protein embeddings + RNA CNN branch

v3_esm2_rna_cnn.architecture: ESM-2 (650M, frozen, mean-pool) → 1280-d → Linear(256) + RNA CNN branch (256-d) → concat 512-d → MLP [256,64] → logit
v3_esm2_rna_cnn.key_advantage: ESM-2 captures evolutionary protein language; per-residue embeddings encode structural + functional context k-mer and one-hot miss entirely
v3_esm2_rna_cnn.requirements: transformers>=4.35, esm, torch (GPU recommended for ESM-2 inference but not required)
